desc: Compute $L_i = \max(0, H - D_i)$, $R_i = \min(U_i, H)$. If $L_i > R_i$, return False.
Forward pass: $curr = \infty$; for $i$ in $0..N-1$: $curr = \min(R_i, curr + X)$; $U'[i] = curr$.
Backward pass: $curr = \infty$; for $i$ in $N-1..0$: $curr = \min(U'[i], curr + X)$; $U'[i] = curr$.
Check validity: if any $U'[i] < L_i$, return False.
Binary search for the largest $H \in [0, H_{max}]$ such that `check(H)` is True.
Calculate final answer: $\sum (U_i + D_i) - N \cdot H_{optimal}$.
